description: This file defines a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' implementing common functionality for HTTP message requests and responses within the Nyholm PSR-7 library, including header management, protocol version, and body handling.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version used in the message.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an associative array.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specific header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns all header values concatenated as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with an added header value.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified body stream.
